heading: Repealed. Sept. 12, 1950, ch. 946, title III, § 301(106), 64 Stat. 844

notes.text: Section, acts June 20, 1874, ch. 328, § 1, 18 Stat. 99; June 10, 1921, ch. 18, § 215, 42 Stat. 23, made it duty of secretary of each Territory to furnish annual estimates for expenses to Secretary of the Treasury.
